title: Wave 16 hazard/escape/ending RED-first Edit contracts
greenCompletionCondition: Fresh Wave 15 prerequisite GREEN, infrastructure PASS, and zero Wave 16 EXPECTED_GAP/FAIL checks on an implementation baseline.

checks.reproduction: Run the PowerShell entry point with -BaselineCommit equal to git rev-parse HEAD.
